en:
Oh! Hey there, Poo-ichi!
I almost didn't notice you!

Then again, a pussy like you will always
be overshadowed by my greatness!
By the way, did you have fun last night?

Hah-hahaha! You act all big and now
you're gonna play dumb with me!?

I can't believe you and Kaito had a public
threesome with that assassin chick!

I-I would never!
W-We were just training, and—

Hah-hahaha! I understand you wanna do it,
but you should wait a little longer!

I'll make the perfect invention so you won't
even need to wear a rubber!

<CLT=cltMIND>What is going on in her head?
She can be a handful sometimes...

<CLT=cltMIND>But what did she mean by "wait"?
And she seems happier than usual...

<CLT=cltMIND>She's not...on drugs or
something, is she?

<CLT=cltMIND>I'm bored of the boys bathroom, I think
I'll try the girls... Just kidding.

<CLT=cltMIND>It's a monitor for communicating with us,
but why is it so...gaudy?

<CLT=cltMIND>And it's not just the monitor,
it's this entire academy.
